what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the Ping app Get the Ping app for iOS, Android or Chrome from the download page .
2 Step 2 : Keep the VPN connected Switch the VPN on and leave it connected. Each 10 minutes of connection adds 1 point.
3 Step 3 : Do tasks for boosts Complete the tasks offered in the app to unlock boosts that raise how fast VPN points accrue.
4 Step 4 : Read the points rules The Ping Points documentation explains seasons, boosts and the end-of-season snapshot.
